subtasks: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
Regrasp the hammer lying diagonally across the rim and place it flat in the hammer-shaped recess, with its head at the back and handle toward the front.
Pick up the adjustable wrench on the left and place it flat in its matching wrench recess. Leave the hammer seated.
Recover the adjustable wrench resting against the outside left wall of the toolbox. Lift it clear and place it flat in the wrench-shaped recess next to the hammer.
Use the right gripper to place the yellow tape measure flat into its matching toolbox recess. Keep the left arm clear.
Lift the right gripper clear of the tape measure, then pick up the pliers on the right and place them flat in their matching toolbox recess.
Regrasp the pliers by their exposed steel head at the right rim. Lift and turn them to fit flat into the pliers recess in the upper half of the toolbox.
Pick up the pliers at their yellow grips on the right rim and place them flat in the upper toolbox recess with their handles to the right.

Return the open right arm to its initial pose. With the left gripper, recover the wrench leaning against the outside left wall and place it flat in the long recess along the front edge, then return the left arm open.
Return the open left arm to its episode-start pose at the front left and hold the open right arm at its initial pose.
